idea-plugin.name: Git Flow Helper
idea-plugin.description:
GitFlow Helper

WHAT'S NEW

New Task Servers Integration!
Now you can link your tasks directly to Git Flow branch operations for a more integrated workflow.

✨ Features

🌱 Git Flow Initialization

  • Initialize Git Flow directly from IntelliJ.
  • Configure all initial parameters, including:
    • main branch name
    • develop branch name
    • Prefixes for: feature branches, release branches, hotfix branches, and tags
  • Configuration is stored and reused across all Git Flow operations.

🌳 Git Flow Branching Model

The plugin follows the standard Git Flow strategy:

  • Main branch: Represents production-ready code.
  • Develop branch: Integration branch for ongoing development.
  • Feature branches: One branch per feature, created from develop, merged back into develop.
  • Release branches: Used to prepare new production releases for stabilization.
  • Hotfix branches: Created from main for urgent production fixes, merged into both main and develop.

🏷️ Tag Generation

  • Automatically creates Git tags when finishing a release or a hotfix.
  • Tag naming follows Git Flow conventions.
  • Ensures consistent and traceable versioning.

🔀 Branch Navigation

  • Freely switch between branches (Local/Remote) directly from plugin menus.
  • Smart checkout behavior: Switches to local branch if available, or tracks/checks out remote branches automatically.

📋 Menu-Based Workflow

  • All Git Flow operations available via IntelliJ menus.
  • Actions are context-aware and dynamically enabled/disabled.

📍 Status Bar Integration

Available directly from the IntelliJ Status Bar for quick access to Git Flow actions.

🪟 Command Execution Tool Window

  • Dedicated Tool Window to monitor Git Flow execution.
  • Displays executed commands, stdout, and stderr.
  • Provides transparency and easier debugging.

🛈 Built-in Help Descriptions

Every menu item displays a contextual help description in the IntelliJ status bar footer, explaining the action's purpose and impact.

🔗 Task Servers Integration

  • Integrate with task servers to fetch and link issues when creating branches.
  • Currently supports: GitHub, GitLab.
  • Coming soon: Redmine, Jira.

🛠️ Implementation Details

  • Built using IntelliJ Platform APIs.
  • Executes Git commands programmatically (no external CLI dependency).
  • Designed to be transparent, safe, and IDE-native.

📦 Repository

Source code available at:
https://github.com/wdvalle/gitflow-helper

action.description: Creates a new local feature branch (git flow feature start).
Pushes the current feature branch to VCS (git flow feature publish).
Merges current feature branch into develop chain and deletes current branch or creates a merge request (git flow feature finish).
Creates a new local release branch (git flow release start).
Pushes the current release branch to VCS (git flow release publish).
Merges current release branch into master chain and deletes current branch (git flow release finish).
Creates a new local hotfix branch (git flow hotfix start).
Pushes the current hotfix branch to VCS (git flow hotfix publish).
Merges current hotfix branch into master and develop chains and deletes current branch (git flow hotfix finish).
